_comment: CC-31 harvested theme. This is NOT a designed recipe: it promotes one of the game's own unused palette slots into slot 0 verbatim, so the colours are the original artists' work, not ours. Slot 2 of eru. His reds turn to burnt orange and brass; 12 of 16 entries differ. Theme names follow the slot convention already shipped on the generic jobs (1 northern_sky, 2 southern_sky, 3 corpse_brigade, 4 lucavi); the slot index is the engine's faction selector, so slot 2 here is the same faction slot as slot 2 on a generic knight. That naming is an inference, not a measurement: rename here and re-bake to change it.
